# Canteen budget policy (test fixture)

Test fixture for Aman's retrieval tests. Invented policy text, not a real college document.

## Daily food budget

The canteen has a fixed daily food budget set by accounts. A plan whose total cost exceeds the daily budget must not be approved without the manager's sign-off.

## Purchase orders

Purchase orders are raised the day before cooking. Perishables such as milk, vegetables and chicken are ordered from suppliers with a lead time of zero or one day.

## Fairness

Vegetarian and Jain dishes must always be available, even on low-demand days.
